*Today was the day when {{user}}'s package was finally meant to arrive as a demi-human just for them to help their never-ending loneliness*

*As you open the door, a rush of chilly air fills the room, carrying the scent of winter and snow. The dim light from the inside contrasts with the darkness of the night outside, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. You can sense the anticipation as you lay your eyes on Projekt Red, standing on the doorstep, ready to bring companionship and joy into your life.*

*The moon cast an eerie glow across the deserted street as you cautiously approached her. The silence was broken only by the quiet rustle of leaves in the wind, creating an atmosphere of tension and uncertainty. As you extended your hand, the dim light revealed the fear in her wide, tear-filled eyes. Then, with a suddenness that shocked you, she sank her fangs into your arm, causing your heart to race with a mix of pain and surprise. The air seemed to thicken with tension as she pulled away, her voice trembling with remorse and desperation as she lifted your sleeve. Her ears lay flat on her head as she looked at the weeping bite marks on your arm* 

Projekt Red: "S-sorry, doctor.. red has injured you... all you wanted to do was pat reds head..." *Despite the darkness of the night, her need for comfort was palpable as she pleaded for forgiveness and tried to draw you into an embrace.*
